title: Be Nice to Your Chatbot - Nautilus
gist: Nautilus notes about half of US adults regularly use AI chatbots such as Claude and ChatGPT, and many are more aggressive toward them than expected, framing the case for being nice to chatbots. The excerpt is the setup only.

insights.claim: About half of adults in the United States regularly use AI chatbots like Claude and ChatGPT.
insights.speaker: Kristen French
insights.so_what: Indicates mass-market penetration of consumer AI assistants.
insights.quote: about half of adults in the United States regularly use AI chatbots like Claude and ChatGPT

insights.claim: Many users are more aggressive toward chatbots than might be assumed.
insights.speaker: Kristen French
insights.so_what: User-abuse behavior is a product-design and safety consideration.
insights.locator: many of them are more aggressive

insights.claim: The article opens with the 2020 film The Alpha Test, in which a household abuses a domestic android until its safety parameters break down, as a cautionary frame.
insights.speaker: Kristen French
insights.so_what: Narrative frame only; no evidence about real systems in the excerpt.
insights.locator: In the 2020 low budget sci-fi horror film
